user.title: Veolia account
user.description: Log in with your eau.veolia.fr account (residential or business). Read-only: nothing is changed on the account.

reauth_confirm.title: Veolia password refused
reauth_confirm.description: Veolia refused the stored password for {username}. Polling is stopped until you enter a valid one.

code.title: Verification code
code.description: Veolia sent a verification code to {username} (first login from a new place). Enter it here; it is valid for a few minutes.

error.invalid_code: Veolia refused this code (wrong or expired).

abort.no_subscriptions: No subscription found on this account.

init.title: Veolia options

data.backfill_months: History to import at first start (months)
data.closed_weekdays: Days when the building is empty
data.leak_threshold_l: Leak threshold on a closed day (L)
data.leak_consecutive_days: Closed days in a row above the threshold
data.leak_repair_issue: Raise a Repairs issue when a leak is possible

init.description: Closed days are the days when the building is empty: the weekdays below, plus every day covered by an event of the holiday calendar, if one is chosen.

data_description.holiday_calendar: Every day covered by an event of this calendar counts as a closed day. Use all-day events.

auth_refused.title: Veolia refused the password
auth_refused.description: Veolia refused the login ({code}). The integration has stopped polling and will not try again: re-authenticate it from the integrations page.

possible_leak.title: Possible water leak (Veolia {subscription})
possible_leak.description: The water volume of the last {days} closed day(s) is above the threshold of {threshold} L: {volumes}. On a day when the building is empty this points to a continuous flow: a running flush, a dripping tap or a leak. This issue disappears by itself once a closed day is back under the threshold. The thresholds are in the options of the integration.
